# Proses MA (2)
## Pembangkitan Model
```{r}
set.seed(1048)
wn <- rnorm(300)
ts.plot(wn)
```
```{r}
ma <- wn[1]
ma[2] <- wn[2] + 0.4 * wn[1] 

for(i in 3:300){
   ma[i] <- wn[i] + 0.4 * wn[i - 1] + 0.6 * wn[i - 2] 
}
ma
```

```{r}
set.seed(1048)
ma2 <- arima.sim(list(order=c(0,0,2), ma=c(0.4, 0.6)), n=300)
ma2
```
## Plot Time Series
```{r}
ts.plot(ma)
```
```{r}
ts.plot(ma2)
```
## Plot ACF
```{r}
acf(ma,lag.max = 20)
```
```{r}
acf(ma2,lag.max = 20)
```
## Plot PACF
```{r}
pacf(ma)
```

```{r}
pacf(ma2)
```

## Plot EACF
```{r}
TSA::eacf(ma)
```
```{r}
TSA::eacf(ma2)
```
